text.p: British independent Quantum Gas Management Ltd said on Tuesday it has bought Vector Gas Ltd, a retail joint venture between Scottish Hydro Electric and Marathon Oil Co of the U.S.

Quantum is preparing for a London stock market flotation later this year to raise money for further acquisitions and for entry into the domestic market, which is being opened for competition in stages and should be fully open during next year.
"We expect to be in that market by the end of this year," said Quantum's newly-appointed retail gas division managing director Mark Petterson.
Petterson was Managing Director of Total Gas Marketing Ltd until the end of 1996 before his appointment as Deputy Managing Director of Quantum Energy Group..

Quantum said in a statement it supplies nearly two percent of business users in the British gas market, achieved both by building up its own business since 1994 and by taking over the customers and systems of Bell Gas in March this year.

Nick Clarke, Managing Director of Quantum Energy Group, added "This is a further major step for us in the retail gas sector. We expect to continue to grow throughout this year both organically and by acquisitions."
